verdict.rationale: Origin-country guidance is a fair question for an immigration law firm, but the evidence pack shows no country-specific pages, consulate-processing guidance, or per-country backlog content. The NIW premium-processing article and general founder-facing pages are not specific to any origin country, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
